title: Check Directory Exists
description: Verify that a required directory exists and is accessible.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

DIRECTORY="${1:-}"

if [[ -z "$DIRECTORY" ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 /path/to/directory" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if [[ -d "$DIRECTORY" && -x "$DIRECTORY" ]]; then
    echo "OK: Directory exists and is accessible: $DIRECTORY"
else
    echo "ERROR: Directory is missing or inaccessible: $DIRECTORY" >&2
    exit 1
fi
